menu.title: Menu
menu.name: Name
menu.deleteHint: Past orders and bills keep this item. It only leaves the menu.
menu.empty: No items yet. Add your first item.
menu.priceInvalid: Enter a price of 0 or more.
tables.title: Tables
tables.deleteHint: Only a table that never had an order can be deleted. Its QR code stops working.
tables.cannotDelete: This table has orders, so it cannot be deleted. Mark it not in use instead.
store.title: Store profile
store.gstinHint: 15 characters, e.g. 24AAACC1206D1ZM. Leave empty if not registered.
store.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 512 KB.
settings.title: Settings
settings.presetsHint: Pick your type of outlet. You can still change each setting below.
settings.takeawayNeedsName: Ask the customer's name for takeaway
settings.maxItemQuantity: Most of one item in an order
settings.menuTextSize: Dish name size on the POS
settings.menuTextSizeHint: Small fits long names like Kathiyawadi Thali; large is easier to read from a distance.
platform.title: Restaurants
platform.outletHint: For example the area or road.
platform.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol. Give it to the owner privately.
platform.disableHint: Its staff are signed out within a minute and cannot sign in until you enable it again. No data is deleted.
platform.added: Restaurant added. The owner can sign in now.
signup.title: Start your free trial
signup.link: New restaurant? Start a 30-day free trial
signup.plans: {days} days free, no card needed. Then {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year, paid by UPI or bank transfer.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with a capital letter, a small letter, a number and a symbol.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signup.agree: By starting the trial you agree to our
legal.draft: Draft for review – not yet in force.
legal.englishOnly: This page is in English only.
pricing.title: Simple pricing, no hidden charges
pricing.trial: {days} days free trial with every feature. No card needed.
pricing.payBy: Paid by UPI or bank transfer.
pricing.f1: Billing counter and kitchen screen with tokens
pricing.f2: GST bills in English, Gujarati and Hindi
pricing.f3: UPI QR with the exact amount, cash and card
pricing.f5: Menu from a photo, sizes, extras and combos
pricing.f6: Day close, reports and Tally export
pricing.f7: Keeps billing when the internet is down
pricing.f8: Staff logins, PINs and manager approvals
pricing.demo: Ask for a demo on WhatsApp
pricing.demoText: Hello, I would like a demo of the restaurant POS.
pricing.shopPc: Want bills only on your own shop PC, without the cloud? Ask us about the shop-PC edition.
signup.closed: Signup is not open here. Please contact support.
sub.overdue: Payment is due. New orders stop on {date}.
sub.suspended: The subscription has ended: new orders and bills are stopped. Everything stays viewable.
sub.howToPay: Pay {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year by UPI or bank transfer and send the details on WhatsApp to {phone}.
sub.howToPayNoPhone: Pay {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year by UPI or bank transfer; contact support for the details.
scan.title: Scan a paper menu
scan.intro: Take clear, straight photos of each menu page (up to 4). Nothing is saved until you check the list and press Add.
scan.reading: Reading your menu… this can take up to a minute.
scan.orCsv: Or upload a CSV file (in Excel: Save As → CSV)
scan.reviewHint: Untick anything wrong, fix names and prices, then add them. Items already on your menu start unticked.
scan.rowPrice: Row {row}: enter a price between 0 and 100000.
scan.nothingFound: No dishes were found. Try clearer photos, or upload a CSV.
print.scanToPay: Scan to pay with any UPI app
approvalRules.title: Manager PIN
approvalRules.reprint: Cashiers need a manager PIN to print a bill again
approvalRules.hint: Void and credit notes always need a manager. Turn this off if reprints are common at your counter.
feedback.title: Guest feedback
feedback.none: No feedback yet. Turn on the feedback QR on the Store page.
feedback.question: How was your visit?
feedback.chooseStars: Tap the stars to rate your visit.
feedback.given: Thank you, we already have your feedback for this bill.
feedback.notFound: This feedback link does not work any more.
feedback.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a minute.
feedback.settingLabel: Print a feedback QR on every bill
feedback.settingHint: Guests scan it, give 1 to 5 stars and a comment, without an app or sign-in. Read them under Feedback.
review.title: Google review QR on bills
review.label: Google review link
review.hint: In Google Maps open your restaurant, tap Share or Ask for reviews and paste the link here. Bills then print a QR code for guests. Leave empty for none.
review.invalid: Paste the full link starting with https://
bill.title: Bill
bill.noUpi: Add your UPI ID in billing settings to show a QR code.
bill.cashTooLow: Cash received is less than the amount.
billing.title: Billing settings
billing.gstinHint: GST bills need your GSTIN. Add it on the Store page.
billing.billPrefixHint: 1 to 3 letters or digits. Bills look like INV/26-27/000001.
billing.upiId: UPI ID for the payment QR
billing.upiIdHint: For example yourshop@okaxis. Leave empty to hide the QR.
billing.upiName: Name shown in the UPI app
billing.smallChange: Small change a cashier may waive (₹)
billing.smallChangeHint: When a guest is a few rupees short after paying, the cashier can close the bill. 0 turns it off.
dayClose.title: Day close
dayClose.openingHint: Count the cash in the drawer before the first bill.
dayReport.title: Day report
credit.title: Credit note for this bill
staff.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. A manager types it on the cashier's screen to allow a void, credit note or reprint.
pos.savedOffline: No connection. The order is saved on this till and will be sent by itself.
pos.offlineMenu: No connection: using the menu saved at {time}.
offline.refusedToast: An offline order was not accepted. See the message at the top.
licence.title: Shop licence
licence.bannerLocked: Billing is stopped on this PC.
licences.title: Shop licences
licences.daysHint: Empty means 30 days for a trial and 365 days for yearly.
licences.daysInvalid: Enter a number of days from 1 to 1100.
licences.stopHint: The shop PC locks when its 7-day lease runs out.
licences.resetHint: Use this when the shop moves to a new PC. The next PC that uses the key becomes its PC.
about.title: About
about.copied: Details copied. Paste them in your message to support.
about.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the details and copy them by hand.
about.noContact: Support contact details are not set up yet.
about.openSourceHint: The POS is built with these free libraries. Each one is used under its own licence.
support.title: Support details
support.intro: Every restaurant sees these in the footer and on the About page. Shop PCs get them with their next licence renewal.
support.phoneHint: Digits, spaces and an optional + at the start, e.g. +91 94295 49007.
support.whatsAppHint: Leave empty to use the support phone.
support.hoursHint: For example: 8 AM - 10 AM and 7 PM - 10 PM, all days.
support.websiteHint: Optional. The full address, starting with https://
support.saved: Support details saved. Shop PCs get them with their next licence renewal.
licences.updatesModeHint: Automatic: a new release at night once it has been out 2 days. Early: a new release the first night (pick a few trusted shops). Paused: no updates. Kept on: stays on one version (never goes back to an older one).
licences.updatesSaved: Updates for {name} saved. The shop PC gets it with its next licence renewal.
licence.update.title: Updates
licence.update.never: Not checked yet. The PC checks every night at 03:30.
licence.update.result.rolled-back: Update did not start, old version kept
licence.update.result.offline: No internet at the last check
licence.update.requested: Update asked for. It starts within 2 minutes.
licence.update.confirmText: The POS restarts and is away for about a minute. Do it when no bills are being made. If the new version does not start, the old one comes back by itself.
licence.update.pausedHint: Support has paused updates for this PC.
backup.title: Backups
backup.warning: The last copy off this PC is too old. Plug in the backup USB disk, then press Back up now.
backup.howTo: A backup is made every night at 03:00 and copied to the USB disk named POSBACKUP (or the NAS set up by support). Keep the disk plugged in.
backup.requested: Backup asked for. It runs within 2 minutes; keep the USB disk plugged in.
backup.bannerNoDisk: Plug in the backup USB disk (POSBACKUP); no copy has been made for more than 2 days.
backup.bannerOld: Plug in the backup USB disk; the last backup copy is more than 2 days old.
watch.downText: An update or a restart is running on the shop PC. This usually takes about a minute; this screen comes back by itself.
watch.newVersion: Version {version} is ready. Reload the page when the current order is done.
login.codeHint: A 6-digit code was sent to the platform owner's Telegram. It works for 5 minutes.
login.codeError: The code is wrong or has expired.
login.sendFailed: Could not send the sign-in code. Try again in a minute.
reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: For the owner of a shop PC. Call support for a reset code; it works once, for 24 hours. The PC needs internet for a moment.
reset.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with a capital letter, a small letter, a digit and a symbol.
reset.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with the new password.
licences.ownerResetText: Read this code to the owner: {code}. On the shop PC they open Sign in, Forgot password, and enter it with a new password. It works once, until {time}.
options.allSoldOut: All sizes of this item are sold out.
options.title: Sizes and extras: {name}
options.sizesHint: For example Half and Full, or Regular and Large. The size's price replaces the item's price, and the cashier must pick one.
options.extrasHint: For example Extra cheese +30. The price is added to the item; the cashier may pick any.
options.needName: Every size and extra needs a name.
options.needPrice: Enter each price as a number, like 30 or 12.50.
menu.stationsHint: Send items to their own kitchen screen and KOT, like Tandoor or Bar. Items without a station go to the main kitchen.
pos.tabOpen: Table {number} has token {token} open. New items are added to it.
pos.tabBilled: Table {number}: the bill is already paid. Start a new order for more items.
pos.tabBilledAdd: Table {number} has a printed bill (token {token}). New items join it; print the bill again after adding.
pos.roundAddedBill: Added to token {token}. The bill changed: print it again.
orders.mergeHint: Its items join this order and its token closes. One bill for both tables.
orders.splitHint: Choose how many of each item go to a new order with its own bill.
orders.splitChoose: Choose at least one item to split off.
orders.splitDone: Split off as token {token}. Bill it from this list.
orders.billedFirst: This order has a bill. Void the bill first.
tips.waiterHint: Leave empty for the person who took the order
tips.title: Tips per waiter
tips.hint: Tips are not part of sales or GST. Cash tips are counted in the till shift as cash in.
tokens.title: Order status
menu.hoursHint: Leave both empty to serve all day. Outside these hours the POS hides this category.
recipe.title: Recipe of {name}
recipe.hint: Stock one portion uses. It is taken from stock when the order is completed.
recipe.noStock: Add stock items on the Stock page first.
recipe.incomplete: Choose a stock item and a quantity above 0 in every row.
combo.title: Combo: {name}
combo.hint: Pick the items this combo includes. The bill shows one line at this item's price; the kitchen sees every part.
combo.needItem: Choose an item in every row.
reports.title: Sales reports
reports.tallyHint: One sales voucher per day. In Tally: Import Data > Vouchers. Ledgers used: Cash, UPI Collections, Card Collections, POS Unpaid Bills, Sales, Output CGST, Output SGST, Round Off.
reports.hint: Void bills are left out. Net sales is the total minus credit notes. Category and item amounts are before discount.
reports.noGst: No GST bills in these days.
res.title: Reservations
res.name: Guest name
stock.title: Stock
stock.name: Item
stockReport.title: Stock report
stockReport.valueHint: Value uses the last purchase price of each item.
expenses.title: Expenses today
share.title: {restaurant} – {outlet} · {date}
feedback.lowRating: Low rating: {rating} star(s) for {label} (bill {number}). Please check on the guest.
qr.noMatch: No dish matches. Try another word.
qr.off: Ordering from the table is off here. Please call the staff.
qr.notFound: This QR code is not in use. Please ask the staff.
qr.failed: Could not send. Please try again or call the staff.
qr.sheetHint: Print and put one on each table. Guests scan it to see the menu; when the switch is on they can also order, and orders go straight to the kitchen.
qr.on: Guests can order from the QR code
qr.scan: Scan to see the menu and order
qr.renewHint: The code printed on this table stops working. Print the new one.
qr.renewed: New QR code for table {number}. Print it again.
help.title: Help
platform.demoHint: Adds a sample Gujarati menu and three orders of today (two paid, one billed). Only for a restaurant with no menu and no orders.
setup.title: Setup checklist
setup.left: {count} steps left before the first day of billing.
setup.allDone: All set. You are ready for the first day of billing.
setup.storeHint: Restaurant name, address and phone print on every bill.
setup.billingHint: Choose GST, composition or no GST, and add your UPI ID for the QR on bills.
setup.menuHint: Add items by hand, from a photo of your menu, or from a CSV file.
setup.tablesHint: The table numbers your staff will use.
setup.staffHint: Give each cashier, captain and kitchen screen its own sign-in.
setup.printerHint: Print a test bill and a KOT on your thermal printer (58 or 80 mm).
setup.qrHint: Print table QR codes so guests can see the menu and order from their phones.
approval.pinDiscount: This discount is above the cashier limit. A manager PIN is needed.
discountLimit.title: Cashier discount limit
discountLimit.label: Most discount a cashier gives without a manager PIN (%)
discountLimit.hint: Above this a manager types their PIN on the bill; it is noted in the audit log. Leave empty for no limit.
discountLimit.invalid: Enter 0 to 100, or leave it empty for no limit.
